lots.title: Provision of Planned, Preventative & Responsive Residential Property Maintenance and Compliance Services
lots.description: Document asserts scope to Lot 10 of Framework 6278 via the Appendix 1 reference-form heading. The extracted body is a pre-supplier-qualification (PSQ) reference questionnaire (Appendix 1) plus a covering letter to the nominated referee (Appendix 2); no lot-specific service scope, product scope, pricing schedule, or technical specification is present in this document body. Any residential-portfolio scope (e.g. street properties, hostels, leased temporary-accommodation properties) must be sourced from the parent notice or other Lot 10 documents, not from this appendix.

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Quality of repairs and maintenance works across property types
evaluation_criteria.summary: PSQ referee rating dimension: contractor's quality of repairs and maintenance works and ability to consistently meet required standards across a range of property types. Not an award-stage evaluation criterion.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: How would you rate the contractor's quality of repairs and maintenance works, and their ability to consistently meet required standards across a range of property types

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Response and completion times for repairs
evaluation_criteria.summary: PSQ referee rating dimension: effectiveness at meeting agreed response and completion times for emergency, urgent, and routine repairs. Not an award-stage evaluation criterion.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: How effectively did the contractor meet agreed response and completion times, particularly for emergency, urgent, and routine repairs

evaluation_criteria.summary: PSQ referee rating dimension: management of costs and application of the schedule of rates, including transparency, accuracy of pricing, and control of variations. Not an award-stage evaluation criterion.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: How effectively did the contractor manage costs and apply the schedule of rates, including transparency, accuracy of pricing, and control of variations

evaluation_criteria.criterion: Statutory compliance and health and safety
evaluation_criteria.summary: PSQ referee rating dimension: reliability in maintaining statutory compliance (gas, electrical cited as examples) and adhering to health and safety requirements. Not an award-stage evaluation criterion.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: How reliable was the contractor in maintaining statutory compliance (e.g. gas, electrical) and adhering to health and safety requirements

evaluation_criteria.summary: PSQ referee rating dimension: effectiveness of communication with both the client and residents, particularly in occupied properties and vulnerable households. Not an award-stage evaluation criterion.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: How effective was the contractor's communication with both the client and residents, particularly in occupied properties and vulnerable households
